name: From the Bunker 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: From the Bunker is an intense adventure puzzle escape game where the apocalypse has left you stranded in a desolate, crumbling bunker. With limited resources and danger lurking around every corner, your mission is to outlast the harsh environment, scavenge for critical supplies, and plot your escape before time runs out.
